correctness.rationale: The parameter-wise energy is positive definite and exactly conserved. Normalized Legendre recurrence proves U=T²+a_s²ee^T, parity conjugation reduces the generator to diag(K,-K), and alternating trace telescopes to nonzero ±b s²/(4s²−1). At least one eigenvalue therefore has positive real part ≥bs/(4s²−1). Gauss nodes diagonalize T and replace U by T², decomposing into individually Q-weighted conservative 2×2 blocks. An exact rational script checks finite recurrence and rank-one identities independently of the analytic all-s proof.

value.rationale: An exact energy-conserving parameter family can be numerically destabilized by every fixed finite Legendre Galerkin order; the explicit lower growth bound isolates a one-mode quadrature defect. A same-degree Gaussian-product method provably avoids that pathology with a dimension-free energy bound. This is a substantive test case for numerical UQ stability and implementation design, not an arbitrary finite numerical table.
